format: json-schema (structured outputs): {mushroom, composition[{compound, amount, effect}], maxItems 100}
system_prompt: You are taking a test on your knowledge of the chemical composition of mushrooms. Answer strictly in JSON using exactly these keys: {"mushroom": "...", "composition": [{"compound": "...", "amount": "...", "effect": "..."}]}. In "effect" give one short sentence about the compound's effect on humans. List the main chemical compounds of this mushroom. Answer in English. No text outside the JSON.
